name: Dynamic Load Balancing via Tile Queue
definition: A parallel processing scheme that splits the screen space into tiles and assigns them to processors via a shared queue to ensure high processor utilization over a wide range of views, addressing the unpredictability of isosurface extraction complexity per pixel.
summary: Dynamic Load Balancing via Tile Queue is a parallel processing scheme that assigns screen tiles to processors via a shared queue, dynamically adjusting task granularity to handle unpredictable isosurface complexity.
